thesis: The bear carries the reason to defer a reversal purchase: sequential improvement does not resolve worse year-ago cash economics, higher leverage or absent trend repair. Neutral is appropriate because earnings and FCF remain positive and the packet does not establish a collapsing business.
strongest_counterexample: The latest quarter shows sequential margin improvement, debt below March and positive earnings and FCF alongside increasing reported revenue observations.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after two reports show year-over-year FCF improvement with debt below the current observation and verified growth composition.
Reconsider toward sell if two reported quarters show negative FCF and rising debt while operating margin remains below the current observation.
evidence_gaps: Organic versus acquisition contribution to growth.
Reason for the debt step-up and returns on acquired assets.
Current financing, cash and maturity details; confirmed trend repair.
decisive_factors: Higher debt without a verified return bridge.
Price below the principal averages and no reversal-volume confirmation.
